grader_note: no grade_hypotheses function exists anywhere in bots/, despite the docstring naming it and the site footer claiming theses are 'scored as turns print'. fire_sweeps counts how often the CONDITIONS were true; it is not a record of whether the thesis was RIGHT. Grading needs a turn oracle - which past dates were real tops and bottoms - and that has not been built. Until it is, 0 fires is not 0-for-5.
